name: swimming crawl style
description: A standing or floor drill that copies the front crawl arm stroke. It raises your heart rate and warms the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.
